div.span: The CloudFront-scope web ACL stops floods, bad bots, oversized bodies, unapproved tools and injection in tool arguments before a request can cost a Lambda invocation.

div.b: VPC origin to an internal NLB

div.span: The NLB has only private IPs; its security group admits 443 from the CloudFront origin-facing prefix list. It passes TCP through, so TLS runs end to end from CloudFront to the endpoint.

div.span: The NLB targets the endpoint’s network interface IPs. The REST API is private: its resource policy allows execute-api:Invoke only through this endpoint, and the public hostname answers 403.

div.b: Regional AWS WAF and Cognito authorizer on the stage

div.span: OriginWaf requires the secret header and an mcp/ scope; the Cognito authorizer on every method verifies the token signature and the mcp/api-gateway scope. A bad token never reaches Lambda.

div.span: The same arm64 container as the other patterns, through Lambda Web Adapter. REST APIs buffer responses and time out at 29 s, so the server answers JSON rather than a long SSE stream.
